t: Two conditions, and what comes down afterwards
a: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
p: Inna-lladhīna qālū rabbuna-llāhu thumma-staqāmū tatanazzalu ʿalayhimu-l-malā'ikatu allā takhāfū wa lā taḥzanū…
m: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
